sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive leadership remains dominant with Consumer Defensive posting sustained top-tier performance, while broader market breadth is entirely absent with zero sectors all-green.

Market leadership is concentrated in low-beta and defensive groups, anchored by Consumer Defensive holding sustained strength across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons, followed closely by Healthcare. Energy maintains the top YTD spot, but lacks the broad momentum needed to lift cyclical peers.

Rotation is minimal across the board, though Industrials and Utilities managed modest 5-day rank gains. Meanwhile, Basic Materials and Financials are slipping lower, and Communication Services remains pinned to the bottom of the board alongside Basic Materials with the weakest momentum profiles across sectors.

## Strength
- **Consumer Defensive:** Stands as the sole sustained strong sector, maintaining a top-3 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month periods, backed by a leading momentum score of 0.850 (rank 2).
- **Healthcare:** Solidifies defensive leadership with a momentum score of 0.733 and a top-tier YTD rank of 3.
- **Energy:** Holds the top absolute position with a YTD rank of 1, carrying a moderate momentum score of 0.550.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Industrials and Utilities:** Led short-term improvements over the past 5 sessions, each rising +1 spot to ranks 6 (momentum 0.417) and 8 (momentum 0.517), respectively.
- **Basic Materials and Financials:** Declined the most over the last 5 sessions, falling -1 spot each to ranks 9 (momentum 0.200) and 7 (momentum 0.467).
- **Communication Services:** Anchors the bottom of the momentum rankings at 0.200, tied with Basic Materials, sitting at rank 11.

## Divergences
- **Zero All-Green Sectors:** Overall market breadth is completely fractured, with 0 of 11 sector groups showing positive performance across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD).
- **Consumer Cyclical Disconnect:** Consumer Cyclical shows a relatively high momentum score of 0.600 despite a deeply lagging YTD rank of 10.
- **Technology Momentum Drag:** Technology holds a solid YTD rank of 4, yet its momentum score has softened to 0.483, placing it among the bottom five momentum laggards.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Breadth remains exceptionally narrow with only 3 of 144 groups all-green, led by defensive and consumer-related pockets like Discount Stores and Furnishings, while sharp deteriorations hit beverages and healthcare plans.

Market leadership is highly concentrated in select consumer and insurance pockets. Discount Stores (momentum 0.899) and Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (momentum 0.893) stand out as rare all-green groups with sustained top-36 performance across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons. Furnishings notably accelerated over the past week, gaining 17 spots to reach rank 33. Concurrently, capital goods and cyclicals like Engineering & Construction (+16 spots) and Scientific & Technical Instruments (+15 spots) are pushing higher.

Conversely, aggressive rotational selling has emerged across defensive staples, healthcare, and commodities. Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries plunged 65 spots to rank 103, and Healthcare Plans dropped 43 spots to rank 60. Meanwhile, energy transition and mining segments remain deeply anchored at the bottom, with Solar (momentum 0.023, rank 143) and Uranium (momentum 0.026, rank 142) failing to generate any meaningful traction.

## Strength
- **Narrow all-green breadth:** Only 3 of 144 groups maintain positive performance across all timeframes (week, month, quarter, half, YTD): Discount Stores (momentum 0.90), Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances (momentum 0.89), and Conglomerates (momentum 0.69).
- **Persistent multi-month leaders:** Sustained top-36 rank across 1-, 3-, and 6-month windows is concentrated in Insurance - Reinsurance (rank 9, momentum 0.872), Lodging (rank 10, momentum 0.864), REIT - Hotel & Motel (rank 4, momentum 0.860), alongside Discount Stores, Furnishings, Security & Protection Services, Medical Distribution, and Insurance - Property & Casualty.

## Movers & Momentum
- **Rapid short-term climbers:** Furnishings, Fixtures & Appliances jumped 17 spots (rank 33), Conglomerates advanced 16 spots (rank 55), and Engineering & Construction rose 16 spots (rank 67).
- **Severe downside rank shocks:** Beverages - Wineries & Distilleries plummeted 65 spots to rank 103 (momentum 0.43), Healthcare Plans lost 43 spots to rank 60 (momentum 0.33), and Chemicals dropped 24 spots to rank 42 (momentum 0.39).
- **Momentum cellar:** Solar (0.023, rank 143), Uranium (0.026, rank 142), Other Precious Metals & Mining (0.040, rank 141), and Gambling (0.056, rank 144) remain the market's weakest groups.

## Divergences
- **Fading leaders:** High-momentum groups showing near-term rank erosion include Luxury Goods (momentum 0.60, -9 spots in 5d), Medical Care Facilities (momentum 0.69, -8 spots in 5d), and Medical Distribution (momentum 0.78, -4 spots in 5d).
- **Emerging movers:** Low-momentum segments flashing sudden 5-day rank improvement include Apparel Retail (+13 spots, momentum 0.49), Electronic Components (+13 spots, momentum 0.49), and Semiconductors (+13 spots, momentum 0.42).
